title: Categories

defaultBadge.tooltip: Default category — can be renamed but not archived
defaultBadge.label: Fixed

archivedBadge.tooltip: Kept so your old transactions still show a category
archivedBadge.label: Archived

footerNote: "Fixed" ones are the starting categories — you can rename or recolor them, but not archive them. The ones you create (e.g. "Madrid Trip", "Motorcycle License") can be archived once you stop using them: they disappear from new forms but old transactions keep showing them.
confirmArchive:
Archive the category "{{name}}"?

It will stop appearing when creating new transactions, but old ones will keep showing it.

form.confirmRename: You're about to rename "{{oldName}}" to "{{newName}}". The new name will also apply to all past transactions assigned to this category. Do you want to continue?
